Name: (TDIT) Island Trader Sialia Portrait
Author: Abagaianye
Description:
[b][u][size=5]About The Mod
[/size][/u][/b]Gives the island trader a human portrait for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20414]They Deserve It Too - Portraits for Vendors[/url]﻿ (TDIT). Her portrait is inspired by and intended to be used with Sialia, the sprite for the island trader from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708]Emyn's Diverse Ginger Island[/url]﻿ (EDGI) - I strongly encourage you to download and use EDGI in your game. If you prefer not to use EDGI, however, this does come with a sprite replacement option to allow you to use different Ginger Island overhaul mods (such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9242]Ginger Island NPC Overhaul[/url]) or just on its own if you want to.


[b][u][size=5]Config[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Manage config options easily with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿
[*]Two ethnicity choices: Melanesian (default) and Malaysian
[*]Two hair colour choices: blue (default) or brown
[*]Toggle dialogue change to replace the bird's pidgin English with better grammar (default: true)
[*]Sprite replacement: replace the default island trader bird sprite with a copy of Emyn's original sprite from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708]EDGI[/url]﻿* - default is on, but can be unchecked to allow you to use Emyn's original sprite if using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708]EDGI[/url]﻿ or if you have another mod editing the island trader sprite (or if you just want a bird sprite with a human portrait). The sprite will have blue or brown hair according to your hair colour choice.
[/list]* Note that the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708]EDGI[/url]﻿ sprite (as found in that mod) doesn't fully replace the bird sprite so the image will flicker as bird feathers occasionally appear to the side of her. If you want to use the original, blue-haired sprite that Emyn made but without the bird feathers, ensure "sprite replacement" stays checked and the hair colour is "blue" as I did not edit the sprite itself, merely changed its canvas size to completely cover the bird sprite.


[size=5][b][u]Compatibility[i]
[/i][/u][/b][/size][list]
[*][i]Requires[/i] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20414]They Deserve It Too - Portraits for Vendors[/url] (will not work without it)
[*][i]Strongly recommended [/i]to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708]Emyn's Diverse Ginger Island[/url]﻿ (for immersion purposes - this mod now includes a standalone human sprite so you won't have a bird sprite without EDGI)
[*]Will not work with any other mod that changes the island trader portrait
[*]Only works with Stardew Valley version 1.6 or later
[/list]

[b][u][size=5]Installation[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20414]They Deserve It Too - Portraits for Vendors[/url]
[*]Download this mod
[*]Drag the "(TDIT) Island Trader Sialia Portrait" folder out of the .zip file into your Mods folder
[/list]
To uninstall, simply delete the "(TDIT) Island Trader Sialia Portrait" folder.


[b][u][size=5]Credits
[/size][/u][/b][list]
[*][size=3]My excellent friend [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/suzukiPC]Pau[/url]﻿ for the portraits she drew for this mod. (See their commissions page [url=https://ko-fi.com/suzukiPC]here[/url]﻿.)[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DolphinIsNotaFish/about-me?gameId=1303]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url]﻿ for making TDIT and allowing me to release this alternative portrait mod for it[/size]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708]Emyn's Diverse Ginger Island[/url]﻿ for the idea of having a human island trader and for the original sprite that I have edited for this mod
[/list][b][u][size=5]Updates
[/size][/u][/b][size=3]Please see the Changelog for update information.[/size]
